value.rationale: The four-site chain is the smallest non-star path and contains two geometrically distinct negative long-range transition channels under mixed second/fourth-order smoothing. The exact threshold formula and contrasting \(2\eta\), \(6\eta\), and inverse-strength scalings characterize a physically meaningful positivity loss and recovery across all positive regularization strengths. The finite global adverse-mixing regime is structural, not an unmotivated numerical slice.
